candidate_windows.window_text: In this part, we show additional experiments conducted using $N = 4,8$ numbers of few-shot examples (Table 8, Table 9). The overall trend is consistent with Table 2, demonstrating that Pre-WoMe is robust to different numbers of few-shot examples.
